instruction: Please format the document title (first line) to make it more prominent. Change it to all uppercase letters and make it bold.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires formatting the first line (title: 'Sample Recruitment Phone Script') to be both bold and all uppercase. The evaluator checks if the first paragraph is bold and in uppercase (50% score each).

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly checks both instruction requirements: uppercase and bold formatting of first paragraph
Data flow is correct: getter extracts first paragraph formatting → metric compares against expected values
Expected values are semantically correct: both is_bold=true and is_uppercase=true match instruction requirements
Scoring logic is appropriate: 50% for bold, 50% for uppercase
Postconfig properly saves file to ensure changes are persisted before verification
Uppercase detection uses .isupper() which correctly verifies all uppercase text
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Bold detection only checks text:span elements with explicit styles - may miss bold formatting applied at paragraph level or through named styles. Consider also checking paragraph-level bold properties and named styles for more robust detection.
